description: Checks at session start that git, the GitHub CLI and the gh stack extension are present. Writes nothing when they are. An absent tool gets a line of its own. The extension gets a line only when both tools are present.

hooks.command: if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '{"systemMessage":"\\nshepherd: ⚠️ node not found on PATH"}\n'; exit 0; fi; node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-start.ts"; exit 0
